messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock a time for the API+SDK+Console design review (RFC + pre-read) so engineering + PM + UX + infra can sign off. Priority: rollout policy + auth changes. Options: Tue 9/12 10:00 PT, Wed 9/13 15:00 PT, Thu 9/14 11:00 PT. Who can host? Who absolutely must be in the room?

AJ: I can host the session. Wed 15:00 PT works best for me. Tue I'm on support rotation.

Kai: Thu 11:00 PT preferred for the UX folks, but can do Wed if needed.

Ben: I can make Tue or Wed. FYI we should include a short canary plan section (5m) so infra knows the rollback hooks.

Leah: Thu is rough for me (customer calls). +1 to Wed if that gets the most core reviewers.

Maya: Sounds like Wed is the sweet spot. Can folks react with :thumbsup: if Wed 9/13 15:00 PT works, :calendar: for Thu, :wave: for Tue. I'll close poll EOD PT.

AJ: :thumbsup:

Ben: :thumbsup:

Kai: :calendar:

Leah: :thumbsup: (can move a call)

Maya: Host confirmed: AJ. Agenda draft below — please flag additions. I'll post the final calendar invite and attach pre-read link.

Maya: Agenda (30m total):
- 5m quick context + goals (PM)
- 10m API surface + auth changes (Eng)
- 7m SDK/Console UX impacts + examples (UX/DevEx)
- 5m Canary/rollback + infra checklist (Infra/SRE)
- 3m Decision & action items (owners + owners for follow-ups)

Maya: Pre-read checklist (please skim before Wed):
```
1) RFC doc: /docs/rfcs/api-auth-update.md (read sections 2-4)
2) SDK diff: https://git.redwood.example/repo/patches/sdk-auth-pr
3) Console mockups: Figma link (see frames 'auth-flow-v2')
4) Canary playbook: infra/canary/playbooks/auth-rollout.md
5) Test matrix + smoke tests: tests/integration/auth_smoke.yaml
```

Maya: Specific asks for reviewers:
- AJ: run through the proposed API contract and list backward-compat risks
- Kai: call out any Console UX blockers and required copy changes
- Ben: confirm canary metrics and rollback triggers (SLO owners)
- Leah: confirm PM acceptance criteria + success metrics

AJ: I'll prepare a 1-slide summary of contract diffs. Can someone paste the RFC path in the calendar invite?

Ben: Adding infra checklist items now — pinged deploy-bot for current capacity window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance check: no conflicting infra windows for Wed 2023-09-13 15:00 PT.

Kai: One more note — SDK needs a small breaking-change notice in the changelog if we change error codes. Can we allocate 2 extra minutes?

Maya: Sure — bump SDK/Console section to 9m, trim context to 3m. Updated agenda noted.

Leah: I'll post a short example user story in the RFC thread before EOD so PM + UX alignment is explicit.

Maya: Perfect. I'll send the invite + pre-read links in ~1hr and start a quick poll on required attendees (we may need SRE on-call if Ben wants deep canary review).

Ben: Agree — happy to loop in SRE on-call if the canary section is heavy.

Maya: Thanks everyone — closing poll in 4 hours. If you reacted but later become unavailable, ping here with your new availability.
